discrepancies.what: Three-way version skew: demo pins SDK 2.2.0; current SDK is 3.1.0 targeting API 2.5.0; local spec is API 2.5.1

SDK 3.1.0 exposes 10 methods; spec 2.5.1 defines 12 operations. Missing from SDK: GET /fundamentals (getFdsFundamentals) and GET /segments (getFdsSegments). Spec is authoritative per charter; POST is the SDK-canonical path
Vendor demo never exercises the PIT arm (FundamentalsPointInTimeApi) — no sample exists for the trial's hard-gate endpoints
Response periodicity enum has 13 values (adds CAL) vs request enum 12 — CAL can be returned but not requested

IdsBatchMax30000 schema: name says 30000, description says 250 non-batch / 5000 batch; minItems/maxItems are misplaced INSIDE the items subschema (apply to a string, i.e. no array-length bound is actually enforced by schema). Same malformation on idsBatchMax2000 parameter
BatchStatus startTime/endTime documented as Eastern Time while all PIT payload timestamps are UTC — mixed time-zone conventions in one API

metrics maxItems=1600 vs 400-error example 'getFdsFundamentals.metrics: size must be between 1 and 1' and ids-limit phrasing '(1 metric per ID, for 1 day)' — effective ids x metrics x days budget is contradictory/undocumented

Non-PIT fiscalPeriod dates 'fall back to the most recently completed period during resolution' vs PIT dates being pure filters on period end dates — subtly different date resolution semantics between arms
Segments accepts exactly ONE metric per request (SegmentsMetrics is a plain string enum of 5) unlike fundamentals' metric array
